ASM::client_ip
Description
Returns the IP address of the end client that sent the present
request. Note that this IP address is not necessarily equal to the
address returned by the command IP::client_addr, which is the IP
address of the immediate client found in the IP header as received by
BIG-IP. The latter can be a proxy, in which case the end client IP
address is extracted from one of the HTTP headers, typically,
X-Forwarded-For.
Syntax
ASM
::
client_ip
Examples
when
ASM_REQUEST_DONE
{
log
local0.
"Src IP: [IP::client_addr], End-client IP: [ASM::client_ip]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ASM_REQUEST_BLOCKING,ASM_REQUEST_DONE,ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION,ASM_RESPONSE_VIOLATION
